full_citation: KFF. KFF tracker: America First MOU bilateral global health agreements. Data as of 8 Oct 2026.

short_name: Public Citizen and Partners In Health report

full_citation: World Bank. International Debt Statistics. DataBank extract by creditor counterpart (last updated 5 Nov 2026).
used_for: Coverage check only
notes_and_limitations: The extract was queried by creditor counterpart (AfDB, IDA, etc.), so all headline ratios (debt stocks and service as % of GNI or exports, reserves) are empty; only the concessional share of debt to each creditor is populated. Replaced by WB_WDI_API. To reproduce with DataBank, set Counterpart-Area = World.

used_for: External debt service (% GNI, % exports), PPG debt service (% GNI), external debt stocks (% GNI), interest payments (% revenue): latest value to 2024 and 2019

short_name: WHO NHWA health workforce density (GHO API pull)
full_citation: World Health Organization. Global Health Observatory: medical doctors (per 10 000) [HWF_0001]; nursing and midwifery personnel (per 10 000) [HWF_0006]. National Health Workforce Accounts.
used_for: Latest available density for each signatory
notes_and_limitations: The curated CSVs in The WHO workforce download files contain indicator metadata only (no values), so values were pulled from the GHO API. Latest year varies (2017-2024). Threshold 44.5 per 10 000 (doctors + nurses/midwives) is the WHO SDG index threshold.
